text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hmhmhm!? In the corner of the hallway, the 
one secretly handing something over is…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You two suspicious ones over there! Show 
me what you just hid!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I-i-i-it's not suspicious at all!? It's 
just a super normal book――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hiding it means you have a guilty 
conscience! Come on now, let's see it!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Uuuuuuuugh～! She saw, she saw, she saw…!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What's the big deal? This is just shoujo 
manga, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Y, yes, that's right, Ms. Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
This is… Yeah, it was just a "I'm forcing 
my favorites on you!" sorta thing!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Are you interested in shoujo manga too, 
Ms. Bakushin O? T, to think!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hm? Me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, then, let me take a look, just a 
tad… "The serious class president and the 
delinquent student are attracted to each 
other whilst still repelling one another," 
hmm.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fantastic!! The class president is the 
main character―this is without a doubt a 
masterpiece!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I, is that so? Well, it's sure a 
masterpiece, but…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
In this manga, the process of the main 
character, who was so weak-willed, falling 
in love and becoming strong, I can't get 
enough of it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I've heard that it can be a bit risqué at 
times, though…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hoho, becoming stronger and… growing 
risky…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
――Very well, I've decided! I'm going to 
fall in love, too!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Love will give you Bakushin-like strength! 
I'll win even the riskiest of battles!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ――and that is why!
choice_data_list: So you want to fall in love…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But I have never been in love! What the 
hell is love supposed to do!
choice_data_list: Like finding someone you care about?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But I have never been in love! What the 
hell is love supposed to do!
choice_data_list: Like finding someone you care about?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Mmm-hmm! So what do we do when we find it!
choice_data_list: You should try telling her how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's a way of expressing your daily 
favors. It sure feels good to do that!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Expressing favors makes me feel warm and 
empowered—I get it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll go tell everyone as soon as I 
can! Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I love it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh…! Ba, Ms. Bakushin O…?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I love it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
What? That… I also like your 
straightforwardness, don't you?

The reactions of the girls varied, but 
Sakura Bakushin O's confession caused a 
lot of confusion around her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Huh, I've finished expressing my feelings! 
I'm sure this has made me even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no! I didn't tell the most important 
person!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I love you, trainer! Thank you for always 
supporting me!!!

It's true that both the person who 
expresses her feelings and the person who 
is expressed her feelings feel warm and 
fuzzy.

Sakura Bakushin O's actions were far from 
love, but she had something to gain in her 
own way.

I couldn't think of any advice I could 
give about love, so I apologized honestly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, don't worry about it! Then we just 
have to learn together!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, just in time, Ms. Urara! Ms. Urara!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hello, Ms. Bakushin-o! What's going on?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I need some advice about love! Do you know 
anything about it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Koi～? Say-chan said you caught a lot of 
fish at the pond in the park?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? Then we must head for the 
park as soon as possible!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, here we go! In search of massive 
amounts of love, come on, Baxcene!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, so love is brewing in this pond! Now 
I'm looking forward to it!
choice_data_list: No, I thought you meant the fish carp.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, you certainly have a point. Then 
let's aim for the carp!

My advice seems to have been passed over 
lightly… I made up my mind and decided to 
go fishing with her until she was 
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm-hmm. I'm sure I'm feeling it right 
now, at this very moment.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The thrill of wondering if it will come or 
not. This is the thrill of falling in love 
with a koi!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
She who controls the carp, controls the 
love! I'm sure that's what it's all about!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa! Here comes the carp! I'm 
going to catch it!

After that, the two of us persevered and 
managed to catch a carp.

Sakura Bakushin O was pleased with the 
results: "I feel stronger! I feel 
stronger!
